items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: P.T. And trombone or saxophone? He was a bass player.

ctx.x: That was his last name? Yeah. I heard of Joe P.T. and Buddy P.T. and T.E.T. Roussone.
P.T. And trombone or saxophone? He was a bass player. Did you have a trombone?
Who did I? In that band with Coyne Brad? Oh, sometime, Eddie Summers, that's his, I used to use Eddie Summers. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Did you ever use a piano?
